messages:
marta: deploy-bot shows UNPIN runtime v3.4 -> v3.5 scheduled for canary at 01:00 UTC. tagging runtime/qa/sre.
deploy-bot: Scheduled action: UNPIN runtime v3.4 -> v3.5 (canary). Trigger: nightly-release-window. ETA: 01:00 UTC.
qa-ron: Quick smoke: v3.5 changed a kernel alias and the dedupe path for small-embedding models; staging embed test shows mismatch 502 on a small subset.
arch-lee: Repro: embedding worker returns 502 when kernel fallback picks legacy-embed-handler. Looks like alias table was pruned.
marta: PAUSE UNPIN until triage, please.
deploy-bot: PAUSE unpin action for thread 2660000000. Reason: embed kernel alias regression investigation. (requested by marta)
arch-lee: Opening hotfix PR to restore alias mapping and add regression test: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2105 "fix: restore embed kernel alias for small models"
qa-ron: CI ETA ~20m. I'll prepare 3% canary for embed-only traffic once artifact ready.
sre-amy: Adding alert: embed_502_rate > 0.1% => page.
qa-ron: CI green (2660000150). Artifact ready: runtime:v3.5-hotfix-2105.
marta: Starting scoped canary at 01:40 UTC to 3% embed cohort.
qa-ron: Canary 15m check: no 502s, latency stable.
arch-lee: Good — resume unpin when ready.
marta: Resuming unpin per rollout plan. deploy-bot please proceed.
deploy-bot: Resuming UNPIN: proceeding with staged canary -> remaining canary -> regional rollouts.
sre-amy: Monitoring live; closing watch if no anomalies in 60m.
marta: Closing thread, thanks all for fast turnaround :thumbsup:
